# DiVo Gen²AI Public Release

This repository contains desensitized documentation and source code for DiVo Gen²AI protein design models and pipelines.

## What we publish here

- Technical documentation (desensitized, no upstream tool names)
- Pipeline architecture descriptions
- Model design rationale and innovation highlights

## What we do NOT publish

- Model weights or checkpoints
- Upstream tool-specific configurations
- Proprietary training data or results
- Internal infrastructure details
